text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
"...A long, long race is finally about to 
begin."

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
—Yahoo, Spe-chan. Well, the day has 
finally arrived, hasn't it?

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Well, but losing doesn't mean it's the end 
of the world, so take it easy, take it 
easy...

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
...Just kidding. None of us can stand the 
thought of losing, which is why we're 
standing right here, after all.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Whoa-whoa, throwing down the gauntlet 
already? Spe-chan never changes, does she?

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
...Well, even so. Just for today—I'll take 
it head-on.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Well then... shall we get going?
